cat <<EOF > /tmp/repro.py
from rich.text import Text

t = Text("hello")
print(f"Initial length: {len(t)}")

# Test with list of tuples
t.append_tokens([(" world", None)])
print(f"Length after list: {len(t)}")
print(f"Text: {t.plain}")

# Test with generator of tuples
def token_gen():
    yield ("!", None)
t.append_tokens(token_gen())
print(f"Length after generator: {len(t)}")
print(f"Text: {t.plain}")

# Test with empty generator
def empty_gen():
    if False:
        yield "something"
t.append_tokens(empty_gen())
print(f"Length after empty generator: {len(t)}")
print(f"Text: {t.plain}")

# Test with generator that yields something other than tuple of 2
def bad_gen():
    yield "not a tuple"
try:
    t.append_tokens(bad_gen())
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Caught expected exception: {e}")

EOF
